caption: The map turns a question about A into a question about B, and the decider for B answers it. Because the map always halts, a decider for B would give a decider for A, so if A has none then B has none either.

spec.title: Mapping reduction A ≤m B
spec.aria: A left-to-right chain: an input x is turned by a computable map f into f(x), a decider for B answers yes or no on it, and that answer is also the answer for x.
